item.title: Analyzing best and worst Super Bowl LX ads
item.description: Just 30 seconds of highly coveted commercial airtime during the Super Bowl costs as much as $10 million, according to CBS News MoneyWatch. Bill Pearce, marketing faculty member at The University of California, Berkeley, joins to discuss some of the ads from Super Bowl LX.

item.title: Social media giants accused of "addicting the brains of children" as trial begins
item.description: Instagram's parent company Meta and Google's YouTube dispute claims that their platforms deliberately addict and harm children.

item.title: Search for Nancy Guthrie in "an hour of desperation," Savannah Guthrie says in new plea
item.description: "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie issued a plea for the public's help at what she called "an hour of desperation." As Jonathan Vigliotti reports, the search for her missing mom, Nancy Guthrie, has entered its second week with few new leads and no new suspects.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie pleads for public's help in search for missing mom Nancy
item.description: "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie issued a plea for the public's help on Monday at what she called "an hour of desperation" in the search for her mother, Nancy.

item.title: A timeline of Nancy Guthrie's disappearance as search stretches on
item.description: Savannah's Guthrie's mom, Nancy Guthrie, was reported missing Feb. 1, and authorities have still not identified a possible suspect or person of interest.

item.title: U.S. military strikes another alleged drug vessel; search on for 1 survivor
item.description: The U.S. military struck its 39th alleged drug-carrying boat on Monday, killing two people and leaving one survivor who is now the focus of a search-and-rescue effort.

item.title: At least 3 dead, 6 injured when car crashes into Los Angeles supermarket
item.description: A Los Angeles Fire Department spokesperson said the crash at a 99 Ranch Market in Westwood is currently being investigated as an accident.

item.title: 2/1/2026: Minneapolis; The Far Side of the Moon; Boom Chicago
item.description: First, calls grow for an independent probe into Minneapolis shootings. Then, NASA's journey to the far side of the moon. And, the Amsterdam improv club behind comedy legends.
